source.text:
4 Piece | Hotshot

While Reflex Action is active:
Scoring a kill grants Hotshot for 10 seconds.
Buff can be refreshed by retriggering Hotshot.

Hotshot | +20 Stability, +20 Reload Speed, and +20 Aim Assist for Heat Weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons. Additionally, it grants +30 Weapons stat.
